stem:
Harish has a 3-by-3 magic square whose rows, columns and diagonals each sum to 15. He adds 2 to every entry.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The new magic sum is 2, the number added to each entry.
Updating the magic sum is what produces the added 2 on each entry.
The new magic sum is 21, because each of the three cells in a line gains 2.
The new magic sum is 17, from 15 and the printed 2.

teacher.key_rationale: Adding 2 to every entry adds 2 three times along each line, so the magic sum becomes 15+6=21. A substitutes the entry for the sum. B reverses cause and effect. D adds 2 only once.
